source: VS Code wiki, Source Code Organization (edited 2025-10-11)

points.text: `base` (utilities and UI building blocks, usable by every layer)
points.check: src/vs/base exists (common, browser, node, parts, ...; base/browser/ui holds the widgets). eslint.config.js code-import-patterns: src/vs/base/~ may import only vs/base/~, and every other layer's list allows vs/base/~. Scanner graph: files importing base: platform 1,778, editor 718, workbench 4,103, code 20, server 28, sessions 803.

points.text: `platform` (service injection and the base services, with no editor or workbench code)
points.check: src/vs/platform has 112 folders, among them instantiation (createDecorator, InstantiationService). eslint.config.js: src/vs/platform/*/~ may import vs/base and vs/platform only. Scanner graph: platform to editor 3 edges, platform to workbench 0.
points.note: One exception: src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/diffWorkerMain.ts L8-10 imports the editor's diff code (editor/common/diff/*), which eslint.config.js allows by name.

points.check: src/vs/editor exists; editor.api.ts builds the monaco API from createMonacoEditorAPI (standalone/browser/standaloneEditor.ts L502) and createMonacoLanguagesAPI; build/monaco/package.json names the package monaco-editor-core.

points.text: `workbench` (hosts the editor, notebooks and custom editors, plus panels like the Explorer and status bar)
`code` (the desktop entry: Electron main, shared process, CLI)
points.check: src/vs/code/electron-main/main.ts (Electron main), src/vs/code/electron-utility/sharedProcess/sharedProcessMain.ts (shared process), src/vs/code/node/cli.ts (CLI) all exist.
points.note: The shared process now lives under electron-utility (an Electron utility process).

points.check: src/vs/server/node/server.main.ts exists, with remoteExtensionHostAgentServer.ts beside it; eslint.config.js has its own src/vs/server/~ rule.

points.text: the order `base` → `platform` → `editor` → `workbench`, a layer not using the ones above it (the page's layer diagram; its text says `base` serves every layer and `platform` holds no `editor` or `workbench` code)
points.check: eslint.config.js code-import-patterns: base may import base; platform base and platform; editor base, platform and editor; workbench those plus workbench. Scanner graph, imports from a lower layer to a higher one: base to platform 1, platform to editor 3, every other pair 0.
points.note: Two exceptions: a test, src/vs/base/test/browser/actionbar.test.ts L145, dynamically imports platform/quickinput; and src/vs/platform/agentHost/node/diffWorkerMain.ts imports editor/common/diff, allowed by name in the lint config.

points.text: extensions run in a separate extension host process, and the built-in ones live in `extensions/`
points.check: src/vs/workbench/api/node/extensionHostProcess.ts and api/worker/extensionHostWorker.ts are the extension host's entries; services/extensions/electron-browser/localProcessExtensionHost.ts starts it as its own process. extensions/ holds 96 folders with a package.json (the built-in extensions).
